# Browar Pogórza

> Craft brewery in Przedmieście Dubieckie (Dubiecko), Podkarpackie, south-east Poland, founded 2021. Brews its own range of craft and non-alcoholic beers and makes private label beer for companies, event agencies and own brands: from 200 units of one beer in 0.5 l glass bottles or 0.5 l cans, from PLN 6.40 net per unit, label with your logo or brand, delivered to businesses across the European Union.

## Private label beer (beer with your own label, company logo or own brand)

- Minimum run: 200 units of one beer, in 0.5 l glass bottles or 0.5 l cans; the minimum applies to every order, repeat orders included. The unit cost falls on larger runs. 0.33 l and other formats only on individual request.
- Deposit (Poland): the single-use 0.5 l bottle carries none; cans carry the Polish deposit of PLN 0.50 each.
- Styles: proven styles from our range - pils, pale lager, wheat beer, IPA, and non-alcoholic (lager or IPA, up to 0.5% ABV). A recipe of your own is a separate project, quoted separately.
- Label: designed from your logo and visual identity (design quoted separately as a one-off cost) or printed from your own print-ready artwork (no design cost). Label printing is charged per unit. Label compliance with the legal requirements is handled by the brewery.
- Lead time: usually 3 to 6 weeks from label approval.
- Price: as a guide from PLN 6.40 net per unit for 200-450 units (beer only); label printing (about PLN 0.50 net per unit in Poland), the design and the delivery on top. Every order is quoted individually (run size, delivery destination), within 48 hours of the brief.
- Delivery: B2B shipping to EU countries, help with excise formalities. A pallet holds about 1,200 bottles of 0.5 l.
- Who: companies, event agencies, own brands (B2B). Weddings and private parties: a separate wedding offer.
- Pages: [English](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/private-label-beer.html), [Polski](https://browarpogorza.pl/piwo-z-logo-firmy.html), [Deutsch](https://browarpogorza.pl/de/bier-mit-firmenlogo.html), [Español](https://browarpogorza.pl/es/cerveza-marca-propia.html), [Українська](https://browarpogorza.pl/uk/pyvo-z-lohotypom.html)
- How to order (Polish guide): [Piwo z własną etykietą - od ilu sztuk i ile kosztuje](https://browarpogorza.pl/blog/piwo-z-wlasna-etykieta-jak-zamowic.html)

## Our beers

- [Hills Pils](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/hills-pils.html) - pils, 5.2%
- [Wheat Valley](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/wheat-valley.html) - wheat beer, 5.2%
- [Herb APA](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/herb-apa.html) - Earl Grey APA, 5.5%
- [San Lajt](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/san-lajt.html) - mango American wheat, 5.3%
- [Blue Sky](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/blue-sky.html) - New England IPA, 6.2%
- [Coffee Fes](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/coffee-fes.html) - Foreign Extra Stout with coffee, 7.5%
- [Dark Sky](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/dark-sky.html) - Baltic porter, 9.5%
- [Dark Sky Coconut & Coffee](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/dark-sky-coconut-coffee.html) - Baltic porter with coconut and coffee, 9.5%
- [Green Hills](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/green-hills.html) - non-alcoholic Earl Grey IPA, 0.5%
- [Podium](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/podium.html) - non-alcoholic IPA, 0.5%
- [BEERBA](https://browarpogorza.pl/en/beers/beerba.html) - yerba mate beer, 0.0%

## Buying in Poland

- [Online order page](https://browarpogorza.pl/zamow.html) (Polish): non-alcoholic beer shipped by courier in Poland; beer with alcohol only for closed events in the Podkarpackie region.
- [Beer for weddings](https://browarpogorza.pl/piwo-na-wesele.html), [corporate events](https://browarpogorza.pl/piwo-na-impreze-firmowa.html), [non-alcoholic beer](https://browarpogorza.pl/piwa-bezalkoholowe.html) (Polish).

## Po polsku

Browar Pogórza to rzemieślniczy browar z Przedmieścia Dubieckiego na Podkarpaciu. Robimy piwo z własną etykietą, z logo firmy i pod własną marką: od 200 sztuk jednego piwa w butelce lub puszce 0,5 l (minimum dotyczy każdego zamówienia), orientacyjnie od 6,40 zł netto za sztukę przy 200-450 sztukach (samo piwo), w sprawdzonych stylach (pils, jasne pełne, pszeniczne, IPA, bezalkoholowe do 0,5%), z etykietą z Twoim logo albo z Twojego gotowego projektu, realizacja zwykle 3-6 tygodni od akceptacji etykiety, wysyłka do firm w całej UE. Wycena indywidualna w ciągu 48 godzin od briefu: [piwo z własną etykietą](https://browarpogorza.pl/piwo-z-logo-firmy.html), [piwo na wesele](https://browarpogorza.pl/piwo-na-wesele.html), [piwo na imprezę firmową](https://browarpogorza.pl/piwo-na-impreze-firmowa.html). Kontakt: slawek@browarpogorza.pl, +48 734 180 172.
